check.title: Is your name on the voter list?
check.lead: The electoral roll is the official voter list. Your name must be on this list before you can vote. Check your name before each election.

ways.title: With your voter ID number (EPIC)
ways.body: The Electors Photo Identity Card (EPIC) number is on your voter ID card. Select **Search by EPIC**. Enter the number. Select your state. Enter the captcha code shown on the screen. Select Search.

ways.title: With your details
ways.body: Select **Search by Details**. Enter the personal details that the form requests. Select your state, district, and constituency. If there is no result, try a different spelling of your name.

ways.title: With your mobile number
ways.body: Select **Search by Mobile**. Use the mobile number linked to your voter registration. Enter the mobile number. Enter the captcha code. Enter the OTP sent to your phone.

check.result: The search result shows your name, Assembly constituency, part number, serial number, and polling station. Save a copy of the result for election day.

other.title: ECINET app
other.body: ECINET is an official ECI app. Use it to search the voter list or track an application. Get app information at [ecinet.eci.gov.in](https://ecinet.eci.gov.in/).

other.title: Call 1950
other.body: Call the voter helpline for help with your search.

other.title: Ask your BLO
other.body: A Booth Level Officer (BLO) helps maintain the voter list for your area. Use **Book-a-call with BLO** on ECINET to contact your BLO. You can also ask the voter helpline for help.

check.notFoundTitle: If you cannot find your name
notFound: Search again with a different spelling of your name.
Search with your previous address if you changed your address.
If you have never registered, use **Form 6**.
If you registered before, ask your BLO which form to use. Use **Form 8** for an address change.
check.toMove: How to change your address with Form 8

register.title: Get your name on the voter list
register.lead: Voter registration is free. You can apply online or with a paper form. Use **Form 6** for new voter registration.
register.cta: Apply on the ECI voter portal
who: You are a citizen of India.

You must be 18 on a qualifying date: 1 January, 1 April, 1 July, or 1 October. If you are 17, you can apply in advance with Form 6. Registration takes effect for the qualifying date when you meet the age requirement.
You normally live at the address where you apply.
You are not registered at another address. You meet the other legal requirements for voter registration.
register.photo: Use a recent colour photo with a white background. The photo must be 4.5 cm high and 3.5 cm wide. Your full face must be visible. Keep your eyes open.
register.ageTitle: Proof of age: select one document
age: Class 10 or Class 12 certificate that shows your date of birth
register.addressTitle: Proof of address: select one document
address: Water, electricity, or gas bill for the address (at least 1 year)
Current passbook from a nationalized bank, scheduled bank, or post office
register.docsNote: Read the current Form 6 instructions for document requirements. The form permits some documents in a family member's name, subject to conditions. If you have no listed document, ask your BLO about other proof. If you have no Aadhaar number, select that option on the form.

steps.title: Open the voter portal
steps.body: Go to [voters.eci.gov.in](https://voters.eci.gov.in/) or open the ECINET app.

steps.title: Create an account
steps.body: Select the option to create an account. Enter your mobile number. Enter the OTP sent to your phone.

steps.title: Enter your personal details
steps.body: Complete each field in the form. Check your name, date of birth, and address for errors.

steps.title: Upload the documents
steps.body: Upload your photo. Upload your proof of age. Upload your proof of address. Make sure each image is clear.

steps.title: Submit the application
steps.body: Check the completed form. Submit the application. Save the reference number to track your application.

steps.title: Prepare for an address check
steps.body: A BLO may visit your address. Keep your original documents available for the check.

steps.title: Track the application and get your voter ID
steps.body: Use the reference number to track your application on the voter portal. After approval, check your name on the voter list. Download your e-EPIC, the digital voter ID, from the voter portal. Your voter ID card is delivered free by Speed Post.

register.offline: Complete a paper Form 6. Give it to your BLO or the Electoral Registration Officer (ERO) for your area.
otherForms: **Form 6A**: voter registration for eligible Indian citizens who live outside India.
**Form 8**: address changes or corrections to an existing voter registration.
**Form 7**: objections to an entry or requests to remove an entry from the voter list.
register.timing: Apply well before the election. The law stops changes to the list after the last date for nominations until the election ends. A pending application does not give you the right to vote. Check that your name is on the voter list.
register.warning: Do not give false information. A false declaration can result in a prison sentence, a fine, or both. See Section 31 of the Representation of the People Act, 1950.

move.title: Moved to a new city for work?
move.lead: Do you rent a room or flat away from home for work or study? You can register at only one address. This must be the place where you normally live. Use **Form 8** to apply for an address change.
move.cta: Open Form 8 on the ECI voter portal
problem: Many people rent a room or flat in another constituency for work. Their voter registration stays at their previous address. Travel costs and time away from work can prevent them from returning to vote.
In the 2019 general election, turnout was 67.4%. More than 30 crore registered voters did not vote. ECI identified internal migration as one of the main reasons for missed votes.
In December 2022, ECI proposed a Remote Electronic Voting Machine (RVM) for people who move within India. The proposal would let them vote for their home constituency from a remote polling station.
The cited announcement describes a prototype and consultation. It does not confirm an available voting service. Check current ECI instructions for your election before you plan to use remote voting.
move.shiftTitle: Change it if your normal address has changed
shift: You now normally live in this city for work or study.
You plan to stay and want to vote where you live.
Apply with Form 8 before the election deadline. Check your name on the voter list after approval.
move.stayTitle: Keep it at home if your absence is temporary
stay: Your home remains your normal place of residence.
You are away for a short time and plan to return.
Plan your travel to your registered polling station for election day. Ask your ERO if you are unsure which address applies.
move.decideNote: Do not register at two addresses. Your property ownership or travel plans do not by themselves determine your normal place of residence.
move.proofLead: Use proof for your new address. Form 8 permits some documents in a family member's name, subject to conditions. Read the form before you apply.
proof: Current passbook from a nationalized bank, scheduled bank, or post office
Water, electricity, or gas bill for the address (at least 1 year)
move.tipsTitle: Address proof for tenants and students
tips: If needed, update the address in your bank account or Aadhaar first. Use the updated document as proof.
Ask your landlord or paying guest accommodation owner for a registered rent agreement.
Eligible students can register at their hostel address where they normally live.
If you have no listed document, ask your BLO or ERO about other proof of address.
move.stepsTitle: Apply for an address change in 6 steps

steps.title: Find your voter registration
steps.body: Search for your name on [electoralsearch.eci.gov.in](https://electoralsearch.eci.gov.in/). Record your EPIC number.

steps.title: Log in to the voter portal
steps.body: Go to [voters.eci.gov.in](https://voters.eci.gov.in/) or open the ECINET app. Log in to your account.

steps.title: Select the address change option
steps.body: Select **Form 8**. Select **Shifting of Residence**, the option for an address change.

steps.title: Enter your new address
steps.body: Complete the address fields. Upload your proof of address.

steps.title: Submit the application
steps.body: Check the completed form. Submit the application. Save the reference number. A BLO may visit your address.

steps.title: Check the result
steps.body: Track your application with the reference number. After approval, check your name on the voter list at your new address. Follow the ERO instructions for the replacement voter ID card.

move.sirTitle: Is your state revising its voter list?
move.sir: Special Intensive Revision (SIR) is a check of the voter list. Check your name on the draft list during this process. Ask your BLO about the required forms and documents if your name is missing.
move.toDeadlines: See SIR dates for your state

deadlines.title: Election and voter list deadlines
deadlines.lead: Know when to apply, so your name is on the list in time.
deadlines.rule: Apply well before the election. The law stops changes to the list after the last date for nominations until the election ends. A pending application does not give you the right to vote. Check that your name is on the voter list.
deadlines.anytime: You can apply during the year. The age qualifying dates are 1 January, 1 April, 1 July, and 1 October. These are not application deadlines.
deadlines.electionsNote: These are estimated election periods. They are not application deadlines. Use the ECI election schedule for confirmed dates.
deadlines.lastDateToApply: Last date to be on the list: {date}
deadlines.sirTitle: Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of voter lists
deadlines.sirLead: During Special Intensive Revision (SIR), officials check the voter list. Check your name on the draft list. If your name is missing, ask your BLO how to apply.
deadlines.sirPending: No verified schedule is available here for: {states}. Check the official ECI website.
deadlines.sirEarlier: Earlier phases covered Bihar in 2025, and 12 states and union territories that were scheduled to finish in February 2026.
deadlines.checkCeo: Dates can change. Check your state Chief Electoral Officer (CEO) website before you use a date shown here.

about.title: About VotersRise
about.lead: VotersRise is a free, independent guide for voters in India.
about.why: Every election, people find out too late that their name is missing, or they are stuck in a city far from where they are registered. The official information exists, but it is spread across many websites and is hard to follow. We put the key steps in one place, in plain language, in every scheduled language of India.
about.independent: We are not part of ECI or a political party. This site has no application forms or advertising. Submit voter applications on official ECI websites.
about.accuracy: Each guide lists its sources. Rules and dates can change. Confirm the current requirements on the official website before you apply.
about.translation: We write every page in English. When you choose another language, the page opens through Google Translate, so its text is sent to Google for translation. Machine translation can make mistakes. If something is unclear, switch back to English or check the official website. Google Translate does not support Bodo and Kashmiri yet.
about.counting: We count clicks on the buttons that open the official Form 6 and Form 8 pages, and show the total on the home page. To count each visitor at most once a day, we keep a scrambled code made from your internet address until the next day, then delete it. We do not store your internet address, use cookies, or track you across pages.
